arts-education.text: Lesly worked for BBHart's from 2019 to 2020, establishing the company's Theatre Program as their lead Theatre Teacher. She worked with a variety of students ages 8-15 to learn basic Fine Arts Etymology, as well as Acting Techniques, Dialect, and much more. Additionally, Lesly assisted in writing the script and text for the company's Winter New York-themed show as well as Directing scenes, applying make-up, building sets and set pieces, and overviewing the selection of show tunes used.
arts-education.caption: Leading The Way for Theatre at BBHarts
